title: Agreement Controls
description: Owner-selected local agreement-prompt handling and backed-up downloaded-app launch metadata changes; never changes consent records.
disableDescription: Stops automatic prompt closing and restores matching backed-up app launch metadata. Agreement prompts may return. Conflicting app changes are reported for review; recorded consent is never changed.
publisher: Unknown Digital and Unknown Suite contributors
permissions: Runs as root; declarations are not a sandbox
Observes application lifecycle events and closes the known optional LG account-prompt apps when enabled
Backs up and changes only recognized downloaded-app agreement launch metadata; restores only matching owned changes

status.title: View current status
status.description: Shows whether prompt handling is requested and its watcher is running, plus launch-metadata changes, errors and any pending app-manager refresh.

health.title: Check module health
health.description: Checks that the requested prompt watcher is running and its launch-policy report has no errors. Not every prompt or future app update is guaranteed covered.

maintenance.title: Reapply saved settings
maintenance.description: Ensures the prompt watcher is running if prompt handling is already saved as ON. It does not accept agreements, enable an OFF preference or restart the TV's app manager.

setPrompts.title: Apply local prompt control

enabled.title: Requested automatic prompt handling
enabled.description: ON closes recognized LG account-agreement prompts and applies backed-up local app launch-metadata changes. OFF stops the watcher and restores matching changes. Neither choice accepts or withdraws agreements.

setPrompts.description: Changes automatic handling of recognized optional LG account prompts and supported downloaded-app launch checks. It cannot grant access to LG services or guarantee an app will launch without agreements.

viewLog.title: View prompt-control log
viewLog.description: Shows recent local prompt-watcher activity and errors, helping identify what was handled. It is not a record of your legal consent.
